external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) has signed an agreement with the Institute of Physics, Belgrade (IPB), Serbia, to foster cooperation in academic and research sectors. The memorandum of understanding was signed during a ceremony held at the University by Sasa Lazovic, Deputy Director of IPB, and Dr. Bismi Gopalakrishnan, Registrar of MGU.

The event was attended by Dr. B. Raneesh from Catholicate College, Pathanamthitta, Dr. Saju Joseph and Dr. K.P. Jayachandran, faculty members of the School of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, MGU, Analytical Engineer A.S. Anu, and research scholar P.M. Muhammad Swalih.

external_collaboration.partner_name: University of North Texas Health Science Centre
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Apex Body of GIAN has sanctioned Mahatma Gandhi University’s first course, “Responsible Conduct of Research -An Overview of Ethical Principles for Scientific Researchers,” developed collaboratively by the International and Inter University Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Mahatma Gandhi University, and the University of North Texas Health Science Centre, United States of America.

external_collaboration.partner_name: United States Department of Agriculture & Agriculture Research Service
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The second sanctioned programme is a workshop on “Microbial Modelling of Pathogens in Foods and USDA – Pathogen Modelling Programme’s Applications in Ensuring Safety of Indian Food Supply” jointly crafted by Prof. Jisha M. S, School of Biosciences, Mahatma Gandhi University and Dr. Vijay Juneja, Microbiologist and Lead Scientist, United States Department of Agriculture & Agriculture Research Service, USA.

The courses are under review at IIT Karagpur, the National Coordinator, GIAN.
